# Align tree column toggle helper lines with ancestor indent lanes

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Observed by `@tobiu` after merging `#21937` (`examples/gantt/milestones`) and reproducible across every `Neo.grid.column.Tree` surface with `showHelperLines: true` (`examples/gantt/milestones/index.html`, `examples/grid/treeBigData/index.html`, `examples/grid/tree/index.html`) in all five shipped themes: on folder and sub-folder rows (`.neo-tree-toggle` with an expand/collapse chevron), the `1px` vertical helper stem above and below the chevron sits `1px` to the right of the ancestor vertical continuation lane drawn by `.neo-tree-indent` in the child/descendant rows above and below it.

## The Problem

`Neo.grid.column.Tree` draws tree helper lines purely in CSS across two sibling flex elements inside `.neo-grid-tree-cell` (`src/grid/column/component/Tree.mjs:68-73`), but the two elements compute their `1px` vertical line x-coordinate with incompatible formulas:

1. **Ancestor continuation lanes (`.neo-tree-indent`, `resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css:41-51`):**
   ```css
   .neo-tree-indent {
       background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
           to right,
           transparent,
           transparent calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px),
           var(--tree-helper-line-color, var(--grid-container-border-color)) calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px),
           var(--tree-helper-line-color, var(--grid-container-border-color)) calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2),
           transparent calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2),
           transparent var(--tree-indent, 16px)
       );
   }
   ```
   With default `--tree-toggle-width: 24px` and `--tree-indent: 16px`, ancestor lane `k` (`k = 0 .. depth - 1`) paints in **`[16k + 11px, 16k + 12px]`** (`center = 16k + 11.5px`).

2. **Folder/sub-folder and leaf toggle stem (`.neo-tree-toggle`, `resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css:53-73`):**
   ```css
   background-position: center;
   background-repeat  : no-repeat;
   background-size    : 1px 100%;
   ```
   Per CSS Backgrounds & Borders (`(boxWidth - imageWidth) * 50%`), a `1px` background image centered inside a `24px`-wide `.neo-tree-toggle` resolves to `(24px - 1px) * 0.5 = 11.5px` and snaps to **`[16k + 12px, 16k + 13px]`** (`center = 16k + 12.5px`) — completely disjoint from `.neo-tree-indent`'s `[16k + 11px, 16k + 12px]` across row borders (`+1 CSS px` / `+3` physical pixels at `3x` zoom).

3. **Unwired `--tree-toggle-width` on `.neo-tree-toggle` (`resources/css/src/grid/column/component/Tree.css:12-17`):**
   `.neo-tree-toggle` hardcodes `width: 24px;` instead of `width: var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px);`, while `resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css:45-48` reads `var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px)`. Any custom `--tree-toggle-width` override shifts `.neo-tree-indent` lanes while leaving `.neo-tree-toggle` fixed at `24px`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.grid.column.Tree` (`src/grid/column/Tree.mjs`) and `Neo.grid.column.component.Tree` (`src/grid/column/component/Tree.mjs`) own tree-column helper lines for both standalone tree grids and `Neo.gantt.Container`'s locked task-tree region.
- `resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css` and `resources/css/src/grid/column/component/Tree.css` are plain CSS sources copied by `npm run build-themes` (`#21217`); per-theme tokens live in `resources/css/theme-*/grid/column/Tree.css` and `resources/css/theme-*/grid/column/component/Tree.css`.
- `.neo-tree-toggle.is-leaf::after` (`resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css:99-102`) starts its horizontal branch at `left: 50%` (`12px` at `24px` toggle width), which already abuts the right edge of `[11px, 12px]` cleanly with zero gap and zero double-painted overlap pixel.
- Design authority: `"The gradients are designed to gracefully 'break' around the Font Awesome caret icons using transparent gaps, avoiding messy intersections."` (`#9521`, commit `489f9b7ad9`) — each depth's vertical helper lane is intended to form one unbroken `1px` vertical line across folder toggles, ancestor indents, and leaf connectors.

## The Fix

1. **`resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css`:**
   - Replace `background-position: center;` on `.neo-tree-toggle` (`line 70`) with explicit `background-position: calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px) 0;` so `.neo-tree-toggle`'s `1px` vertical stem occupies `[16k + 11px, 16k + 12px]`, identical to `.neo-tree-indent`'s `repeating-linear-gradient` stops.
2. **`resources/css/src/grid/column/component/Tree.css`:**
   - Replace `width: 24px;` on `.neo-tree-toggle` (`line 16`) with `width: var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px);` so both `.neo-tree-indent` and `.neo-tree-toggle` share one width authority.
3. **Theme build & Playwright verification:**
   - Rebuild theme output if applicable (`node buildScripts/buildThemes.mjs -n -e dev -t all` or verify live `resources/css/src/` + `dist` parity) and add a Playwright assertion in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/Tree.spec.mjs` verifying that an expanded folder's `.neo-tree-toggle` computed `backgroundPosition` (`11px 0px` at default `24px` toggle width) aligns identically with its child row's `.neo-tree-indent` stripe offset (`11px..12px`), including under a custom `--tree-toggle-width` override.

## Decision Record impact

none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `.neo-tree-toggle` (`resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css`) positions its `1px` vertical helper stem at `calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px) 0`, matching `.neo-tree-indent`'s `calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px)` .. `calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2)` stripe with `0px` horizontal step across row borders at depth `0`, `1`, and `2+`.
- [ ] `.neo-tree-toggle` (`resources/css/src/grid/column/component/Tree.css`) uses `width: var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px)` rather than hardcoded `24px`, keeping `.neo-tree-toggle` and `.neo-tree-indent` aligned when `--tree-toggle-width` is overridden.
- [ ] Leaf horizontal connectors (`.neo-tree-toggle.is-leaf::after`) connect flush to the vertical stem with no gap or horizontal jog across all five themes (`neo-dark`, `neo-light`, `dark`, `light`, `cyberpunk`).
- [ ] Automated Playwright coverage in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/Tree.spec.mjs` verifies vertical helper-line alignment between expanded folder/sub-folder rows and descendant `.neo-tree-indent` lanes (`npx playwright test --config buildScripts/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/grid/Tree.spec.mjs`).
- [ ] PR body includes zoomed before (`dev`) and after screenshots on a multi-level tree (`examples/gantt/milestones` or `examples/grid/treeBigData`) confirming unbroken vertical lanes across sub-folder chevrons.

## Out of Scope

- Suppressing `.neo-tree-indent` ancestor lanes underneath an expanded `is-last-child` ancestor (requires per-depth ancestor-mask state on `Neo.data.TreeStore` / `Neo.grid.column.component.Tree`, separate from CSS lane alignment).
- Changes to `Neo.gantt.Container` bar or dependency SVG rendering.

## Avoided Traps

- **Using `0.5px` fractional stops (`calc(50% - 0.5px)`):** causes `2px` half-alpha subpixel blur on `1x` displays; matching `.neo-tree-indent`'s integer `calc(var(--tree-toggle-width, 24px) / 2 - 1px)` keeps crisp `1px` device-aligned lines at `1x`, `2x`, and `3x` DPRs.
- **Fixing alignment inside `resources/css/src/gantt/Container.css` or an example stylesheet:** the bug lives in `Neo.grid.column.Tree`'s shared CSS (`resources/css/src/grid/column/Tree.css` + `component/Tree.css`) and affects every tree grid in the engine.
